text:
alex: Heads up — invoice preview shows ~0.6% token delta for a cluster of tenants after yesterday's routing change. anyone else seeing this?

maria: saw an alert this morning, digging. suspect fallback routes emitting duplicate charge events when routing table TTL expires.

alex: right — fallback policies -> proto A vs proto B. when the route tag is missing we send to fallback with tag "legacy" and also emit a reconciled event. leads to double counting.

sam: can you paste example event ids? I'll trace in tracing.

maria: example ids: evt_8f3a12, evt_8f3a13

maria: query i ran: ```sql
SELECT event_id, route_tag, emitted_by, billed_tokens FROM billing_events
WHERE tenant_id = 't-123' AND created_at > '2025-12-01'
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
```

jeff: confirmed route_tag null on evt_8f3a13 and then a fallback-emit with same session_id. looks like the enrich job retries on missing enrichment and emits a second checkpoint event.

anya: is the enrich job idempotent? we should dedupe before invoice-ing. maybe add fingerprinting on (session_id, seq_num)

maria: enrich had transient failure (500) then retried with different instance -> enrichment write + fallback write both succeeded. dedupe window currently 2s.

alex: invoice preview batching runs hourly; if retries land outside 2s window we double count. proposal: extend dedupe window to 30s and mark fallback-type events as "ephemeral" until enrichment completes.

sam: extending window might increase memory in aggregator. what's the cost? we need numbers. I'll run a sim.

billing-bot: ALERT: invoice-preview-consumer lag spike at 2025-12-02T09:12Z (consumer-lag: 4500 msgs)

jeff: other option: enrich service write a tombstone event when it retries so downstream can collapse. lightweight and avoids heavier dedupe state.

anya: console UX: customers see ghost charges on invoice preview. can we add a small "provisional" flag in preview UI for events younger than 1hr or with fallback tag? reduces support churn.

maria: +1. Plan: (1) short-term UI flag (console change) (2) add tombstone write in enrich (3) extend dedupe window to 30s behind an experiment flag. I'll open rollout PR.

alex: @sam can you run sim and drop numbers in this thread? after that we coordinate canary rollout (10% tenants) and metric: invoice-delta < 0.1%.

sam: on it. ETA 2h. I'll post results and a small mem/cpu impact table.

oncall-bot: scheduled: deploy enrich 2025-12-02T14:00Z canary -> notify #eng-oncall

alex: thanks. also document runbook: if billing-preview diverges >1% then rollback tombstone change and set preview flag to "show provisional charges".

maria: creating runbook now, will add links to dashboards: billing-preview/deltas, enrich-retry-traces.

sam: sim done — rough numbers: extending dedupe window to 30s increases aggregator mem by ~8% and reduces duplicate events by ~86% in our replay. attaching results in PR.

alex: good enough. proceeding with small canary. I'll open the PR for console change as well.

jeff: ack. ping me if you need help on tombstone schema. we should also add a small event_type enum: fallback, tombstone, canonical.

anya: ping UX to show provisional badge and tooltip: 'Charges provisional while enrichment completes'.

maria: updated runbook + PR links: https://stash.internal/redwood/billing/PR/459

alex: cheers everyone :thumbsup:
